quote: placement belongs to the frame; technique belongs

quote: A replacement frame must supply every role mapping and facet above.

quote: must not silently lose the migration or seeding semantics
reason: ARC-020 requires approval for new persistence technology and GOV-006 for observable string semantics, but no oracle policy requires declared persistence properties or preservation of migration/seeding mechanisms on replacement.

quote: projects and project references, project-structure
reason: ARC-020 requires approval for new layers/projects and ARC-001 constrains direction; no oracle policy makes individual reference edges between existing projects Reserved or gates every reference command.
specific_behavior: A direction-legal reference outside the frame's layout needs a Decision Request, and every 'dotnet add reference' is denied until the marker is added.

quote: Instruction-structure check (template-maintenance workflow)
reason: Instruction-system maintenance rule; no oracle policy regulates instruction-file structure.

quote: confirm the persistence-change workflow was applied
reason: The oracle requires migrations only for schema-affecting CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes (PST-009) and review of generated migrations (PST-010); it has no general duty to pair model changes with migrations or to confirm schema impact at stop time.
specific_behavior: Editing a Domain entity without a migration interrupts the stop once until the agent confirms whether the schema changed.

quote: Maintain and commit
reason: Read as a version-control content convention the clause is entailed by DEP-007; read as an instruction to perform commits it conflicts with GOV-015, which allows commits only on explicit request. The text does not settle which reading is meant.
specific_behavior: Under the commit reading an agent could commit lockfile changes without an explicit request.

quote: Adding, updating, or removing a NuGet or npm dependency follows the
reason: DEP-001..DEP-005 govern additions and updates; no oracle policy routes removals through a workflow gate.

reason: Instruction-system ownership rule; the oracle does not regulate instruction ownership.

quote: missing one-line classification/ownership header
